coverage_assessment: Twelve batched open-web search actions (48 query strings, 323 result headers) in English, Estonian and Russian; included weekly windows, Tallinn/Narva/Tartu, labour/strike, agriculture/environment and Navalny leads. One February lead remains pending evidence; no other eligible event established. Selective search indexing, incomplete regional and sector archives, unreviewed source bodies, unknown turnout/target, and no LexisNexis mean absence of found events is not evidence of no events.
